name: Salesperson annual sales from totaldue
description: When comparing salesperson sales to quota, annual sales are SUM(salesorderheader.totaldue), not subtotal.
sql: SELECT salespersonid, substr(orderdate, 1, 4) AS sales_year, SUM(totaldue) AS total_sales FROM salesorderheader WHERE salespersonid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY salespersonid, substr(orderdate, 1, 4)
